items.example: I work from home on Fridays.
Let's take a short break.
Where did you put the keys?
There is a problem with the printer.
I can't hear you very well.

items.ja: 冠詞・数えられる名詞と数えられない名詞
items.example: Could you give me some advice?
I was cooking when you called.
We missed the last train.

items.ja: 未来の表し方（will / be going to / 予定の進行形）
items.example: I'm meeting a client tomorrow.
You should bring an umbrella.
This one is a little cheaper.

items.ja: 依頼と許可（Could you / May I / Is it okay if）
items.example: Is it okay if I leave a bit early?

items.ja: 時・条件の副詞節（未来のことも現在形）
items.example: I'll call you when I get to the station.

items.ja: 現在完了（経験・完了・継続）
items.example: Have you ever been to Osaka?
The meeting has been moved to Thursday.

items.ja: 不定詞（目的・名詞・形容詞的）
items.example: I need something to drink.

items.ja: 動名詞・動名詞と不定詞の選び分け
items.example: I'm thinking about changing jobs.

items.ja: want / ask / tell + 人 + to do
items.example: Can you ask him to call me back?
This is the café where we first met.
Do you know what time the store closes?

items.ja: 後置修飾（分詞・前置詞句）
items.example: The man standing by the door is my boss.

items.ja: 名詞節（that 節・what 節）
items.example: What I need is a little more time.
I've been waiting for twenty minutes.

items.ja: 時制の選び分け（過去形と現在完了など）
items.example: I lost my wallet, but I've found it now.
The train had already left when we arrived.
If I had more time, I'd learn to cook.
I had my hair cut at the new salon yesterday.
Let's go over the plan once more.
She said she would be a little late.

items.ja: 譲歩・対比（although / even if / whereas）
items.example: Even if it rains, the event will go ahead.

items.ja: 婉曲・柔らかい言い方
items.example: I was wondering if you could take a look at this.
If I had left earlier, I wouldn't have missed it.
Having finished the report, she went home early.

items.ja: 助動詞 + have done（should have / must have / might have）
items.example: I should have checked the schedule before I booked.
I wish I had known about it sooner.

items.ja: 強調構文（It is ... that / What ... is）
items.example: It was the price, not the design, that surprised me.
If I had taken that job, I'd be living in London now.

items.ja: 節の入れ子・長い名詞句
items.example: The person who told me what you had said wasn't sure.
Not only did he apologize, but he also paid for dinner.
